{% extends "docs.html" %} {% from "macros/page.html" import page_body, section, toc with context %} {% set page_name = "Switches" %} {% set page_blurb = "Material Design 3 switches, from the HTML." %} {% block page %} {% call page_body() %} {% call section("anatomy", "Anatomy", heading=false) %}

A <label class="switch"> wrapping <input type="checkbox"> is the control. The label text is a sibling of the input — no .lever required. They are CSS only. There is no JavaScript component and nothing to AutoInit.

Tokens follow the M3 switch spec. The track is 52×32dp. Unselected is surface-variant with a 2dp outline and a 16dp handle. Selected is a primary track and a 24dp on-primary handle. The state layer is 40dp at 8% hover and 10% focus. The touch target is 48dp. The label is body-large / on-surface. Disabled is 38%. 

<label class="switch">
  <input type="checkbox">
  Wi-Fi
</label>

<label class="switch">
  <input type="checkbox" checked>
  Bluetooth
</label>

<label class="switch">
  <input type="checkbox" disabled>
  Airplane mode
</label>

An input + span or input + .lever still works if you already have that markup. 

<label class="switch">
  Off
  <input type="checkbox">
  <span class="lever"></span>
  On
</label>
